a: Kabbelan – amri la meid, veamri la eno meid. amri la meid – kearev dame. veamri la eno meid – denicha leh delehevo bideh tarvayyhu, dechi ate baal chov – may devae shakel.
Amar rabbi yochanan: umman en lo chazaka, ben umman yesh lo chazaka. aris en lo chazaka, ben aris yesh lo chazaka. gazlan uven gazlan en lahen chazaka, ben beno shel gazlan yesh lo chazaka.
Hechi dame? i atu betaneta daavuhon – afillu hanach name la. i dela atu betaneta daavuhon – afillu ben gazlan name!

La tzericha, deka amri edim: "befanenu hoda lo". hanach – ikka lememar kusheta ka amri. hay – af al gav deodi name la meheman, kidrav kahana – deamar rav kahana: i lav deodi leh, hava mamte leh ulechamreh leshachvor.
Amar rava: peamim sheafillu ben beno shel gazlan name en lo chazaka. hechi dame? kegon deka ate betaneta deabba daavu.
Hechi dame gazlan? amar rabbi yochanan: kegon shehuchezak al sade zo begazlanuta. verav chisda amar: kegon devet peloni, shehorgin nefashot al iske mamon.
Tanu rabbanan: umman – en lo chazaka, yarad meummanuto – yesh lo chazaka. aris – en lo chazaka, yarad mearisuto – yesh lo chazaka. ben shechalak, veishsha shennitgarsha – hare hen kishar kol adam.
Bishlama ben shechalak – itzterich, salka datach amena: achole achel gabbeh, kamashma lan dela. ella ishsha shennitgarsha – peshita! la tzericha,
b: Bimgoreshet veenah megoreshet, vechidrabbi zera – deamar rabbi zera amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar shemuel: kol makom sheamru chachamim: megoreshet veenah megoreshet – balah chayyayv bimzonoteha.
Amar rav nachman, amar li huna: kullan sheheviu reaya – reayaytan reaya, umaamidin sade beyadan. gazlan shehevi reaya – en reayayto reaya, veen maamidin sade beyado.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: lakach missikarikon, vechazar velakach mibbaal habbayit – mikkacho batel!
Leappoke midderav – deamar rav: lo shanu ella daamar leh: "lech chazek ukeni", aval bishtar – kana;
Ka mashma lan kedishmuel – deamar: af bishtar name lo kana, ad sheyyichtov achrayut nechasim.

Verav bivi mesayyem ba mishshemeh derav nachman: karka en lo, aval maot yesh lo. bamme devarim amurim – sheamru edim: "befanenu mana lo", aval amru edim: "befanenu hoda lo" – lo; kidrav kahana, deamar: i lav deodi leh, hava mamte leh ledideh velachamareh leshachvor.

Amar rav huna: talyuhu vezabben – zevineh zevine. may tama? kol dimzabben inish, i lav daanis – la hava mezabben, vaafillu hachi zevineh zevine. vedilma shane unesa denafsheh meunesa deacharine! ella kidtanya:

a: "Yakriv oto" – melammed shekkofin oto. yachol beal korcho? talmud lomar: "lirtzono". ha ketzad? kofin oto ad sheyyomar: "rotze ani".
Vedilma shane hatam, denicha leh detihve leh kappara! veella missefa: vechen atta omer begitte nashim – kofin oto ad sheyyomar: "rotze ani".
Vedilma shane hatam, demitzva lishmoa divre chachamim! ella sevara hu – aggav uneseh gamar umakne.
Motev rav yehuda: get hameusse; beyisrael – kasher, uvegoyim – pasul. uvegoyim – chovtin oto, veomrin lo: ase ma sheyyisrael omer lach. veammay? hatam name, nema: aggav uneseh gamar umegaresh!

Ha ittemar ala, amar rav mesharsheya: devar tora – afillu begoyim kasher, uma taam amru begoyim pasul? kede shello tehe kol achat veachat holechet vetola atzmah beyad goy, umafkaat atzmah miyyad balah.
Motev rav hamenuna: lakach missikarikon, vechazar velakach mibbaal habbayit – mikkacho batel. veammay? hatam name nema: aggav uneseh gemar umakne!
Ha ittemar ala, amar rav: lo shanu ella daamar leh: "lech chazek ukeni", aval bishtar – kana.
Velishmuel, deamar: af bishtar name lo kana, may ikka lememar? mode shemuel hecha dihav zuze.
Ulerav bivi, dimsayyem ba mishshemeh derav nachman: karka en lo, maot yesh lo – may ikka lememar? rav bivi memra hu, umemra lerav huna la sevira leh.
Amar rava, hilcheta: talyuhu vezabben – zevineh zevine. vela amaran ella
b: Besade" setam, aval besade zo" – lo.
Uvessade zo" name la amaran – ella dela artzi zuze, aval artzi zuze – la.
Vela amaran ella dela hava leishtemote, aval hava leh leishtemote – la.
Vehilcheta bechullehu dehavu zevineh zevine, vaafillu besade zo – deha ishsha kesade zo" damya, veamar ammemar: talyuha vekaddesh – kiddushav kiddushin.
Mar bar rav ashe amar: beishsha vadday kiddushin la havu; hu asa shello kahogen, lefichach asu immo shello kahogen – veafkeinhu rabbanan lekiddusheh minneh.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: tinach dekaddesh bechaspa, kaddesh bevia may ikka lememar? amar leh: shavveyu rabbanan livilato beilat zenut.
Tavi tela lefappi akkinnara, vezabben. chatam rabba bar bar chana ammodaa, veaashkalta. amar rav huna: man dechatem ammodaa – shappir chatem, uman dechatem aashkalta – shappir chatem.
Ma nafshach? i modaa – la ashkalta, vei ashkalta – la modaa! hachi kaamar: i lav modaa, man dechatem aashkalta – shappir chatem. rav huna letameh – deamar rav huna: talyuhu vezabben – zevineh zevine.
Ini?! vehaamar rav nachman: haedim sheamru "amana hayu devarenu" –

a: En neemanim; "modaa hayu devarenu" – en neemanin!
Hane mille al pe – dela ate al pe umara lishtara, aval bishtara – ate shetara umara lishtara.
Gufa – amar rav nachman: "amana hayu devarenu" – en neemanin, "modaa hayu devarenu" – en neemanin.
Umar bar rav ashe amar: "amana hayu devarenu" – en neemanin, "modaa hayu devarenu" – neemanin. may tama? shezze nittan likkatev, veze lo nittan likkatev.
Velo laish chazaka benichse ishto vechulei. peshita – kevan deit leh lefera, pera hu dekaachel!
La tzericha, dichtav la: "din udevarim en li binchasayich".
Vechi ketav la – may have? vehatanya, haomer lachavero: "din udevarim en li al sade zo", veen li esek bah", veyaday mesullakot mimmenna" – lo amar kelum!
Amri la deve rabbi yannay: matnitin bechotev lah veodah arusa – vechidrav kahana, deamar rav kahana:
b: Nachala habbaa lo leadam mimmakom acher, adam matne aleha shello yirashenna. vechidrava – deamar rava: kol haomer "i efshi betakkanat chachamim" kegon zot, shomin lo.
May "kegon zot"? kidrav huna amar rav – deamar rav huna amar rav: yechola ishsha shettomar levalah: "eni nizzonet veeni osa".
Ha reaya – yesh? tema: "nachat ruach asiti levali"!
Mi la tenan: lakach min haish, vechazar velakach min haishsha – mikkacho batel; alma amra: "nachat ruach asiti levali", hacha name tema: "nachat ruach asiti levali"!
Ha ittemar ala, amar rabba bar rav huna: lo nitzrecha ella beotan shalosh sadot – achat shekkatav lah bichtubbatah,

a: Veachat sheyyiched lah bichtubbatah, veachat shehichnisa lo shum mishshellah.
Lemaote may? illema lemaote shear nechasim – kol shekken dehavya leh eva, deamar la: enayich natat begerushin uvemita!
Ella lemaote nichse melog – haamar ammemar: ish veishsha shemmachru benichse melog – lo asu velo kelum!

Ki ittemar deammemar – hecha dezabben ihu umit, atya ihi umappeka; i name zabbina ihi umita, ate ihu umappek betakkanta derabbanan – vechidrabbi yose bar chanina, deamar rabbi yose bar chanina: beusha hitkinu, haishsha shemmachra benichse melog, umeta – habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot;
Aval hecha dezabbinu tarvayyhu lealma, i name zabbina ihi ledideh – zevina zevine.
Veibbaet ema: ammemar deamar – kerabbi elazar,
Detanya: hammocher et avdo, ufasak immo sheyyeshammeshennu sheloshim yom –
Rabbi meir omer: harishon yeshno bedin yom o yomayim, mippene shehu tachtav; vehashsheni eno bedin yom o yomayim, mippene sheeno tachtav –
Kasavar: kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame.
Rabbi yehuda omer: hashsheni yeshno bedin yom o yomayim, mippene shehu kaspo; harishon eno bedin yom o yomayim, sheeno kaspo – kasavar: kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame.
Rabbi yose omer:
b: Shenehem yeshnan bedin yom o yomayim – ze mippene shehu tachtav, veze mippene shehu kaspo – umesappeka leh i kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame, i lav kekinyan hagguf dame, vesafek nefashot lehakel.
Rabbi elazar omer: shenehem enan bedin yom o yomayim – ze lefi sheeno tachtav, veze lefi sheeno kaspo.
Veamar rava: may tama derabbi elazar? amar kera: "lo yukkam ki chaspo hu" – kaspo hameyuchad lo.
Velo laish chazaka benichse ishto. vehaamar rav: eshet ish tzericha lemachot! beman? ilema beacher – vehaamar rav: en machazikin benichse eshet ish. ella lav bevaal?
Amar rava: leolam bevaal, uchegon shechafar bah borot, shichin umearot.
Vehaamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: en chazaka linzakin!
Ema: en din chazaka linzakin.
I baet ema: lav ittemar ala, rav mari amar: bekutera, rav zevid amar: bevet hakkisse?

Rav yosef amar: leolam beacher, uchegon sheachalah miktzat chazaka bechayye habbaal, veshalosh leachar mitat habbaal; miggo dei bae amar lay: "ana zeventa minnach", ki amar la name: "at zabbenta leh vezabbena nihali" – meheman.
Gufa – amar rav: en machzikin benichse eshet ish.

a: Vedayyayne gola amru: machzikin. amar rav: halacha kedayyayne gola. amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: hadar beh mar mishshemateh? amar lehu: mistabbera amari – kidrav yosef.
Velo leishsha benichse valah vechulei. peshita – kevan deit la mezone, mezone hu deka achla! la tzericha, deyached la ara achariti limzona.
Ha reaya – yesh? lema legalloye zuze hu devae!
Shamat minna, hammocher sade leishto – kanta, vela amrinan: legalloye zuze hu devae?! la; ema: ha reaya yesh – bishtar mattana.

Amar leh rav nachman lerav huna: la hava mar gabban beureta bitchuma, deamrinan mille mealleyayta. amar leh: may mille mealleyayta amritu? hammocher sade leishto – kanta, vela amrinan legalloye zuze hu devae.
Amar leh: peshita, dal zuze mehacha – vetikne bishtara! mi la tenan: nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka?

Amar leh: velav ittemar ala, amar shemuel: lo shanu ella bishtar mattana, aval bishtar mecher – lo kana ad sheyyitten lo dameha? velav motev rav hamenuna: bishtar – ketzad? katav lo al hanneyayr o al hacheres – af al pi sheen bo shave peruta: "sadi mechura lach", "sadi kenuya lach" – hare zo mechura unetuna?
Velav hu motev la vehu mefarek la – bemocher sadehu mippene raatah?
(Rav bivi mesayyem ba mishshemeh derav nachman) verav ashe amar: bemattana bikkesh littenah lo, velamma katav lo bilshon mecher? kede leyappot kocho.
Metivi: lava min haeved, veshichrero; min haishsha, vegershah – en lahen alav kelum. may tama? lav mishshum deamrinan: legalloye zuze hu devae?
Shane hatam, dela nicha leh leshauoyeh nafsheh "eved love leish malve".
Shelach rav huna bar avin: hammocher sade leishto – kanta,
b: Uvaal ochel perot. beram, rabbi abba verabbi avahu vechol gedole haddor amru: bemattana bikkesh litteno lah, velamma katav lah leshum mecher? kede leyappot et kochah.
Metivi: lava min haeved veshichrero, min haishsha vegershah – en lahen alav kelum. may tama? lav mishshum deamri: legalloye zuze hu diva?
Shane hatam, dela lishavve inish "eved love leish malve".
Amar rav: hammocher sade leishto – kanta, vehabbaal ochel perot. bemattana – kanta, veen habbaal ochel perot. verabbi elazar amar: echad ze veechad ze – kanta, veen habbaal ochel perot.

Avad rav chisda ovada kerabbi elazar. amaru leh rabban ukeva verabban nechemya bene venateh derav, lerav chisda: shavek mar ravreve, veaved kezutere?! amar lehu: vaana name keravreve avadi, dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: echad ze veechad ze – kanta, veen habbaal ochel perot.
Amar rava, hilcheta: hammocher sade leishto – lo kanta, vehabbaal ochel perot. bemattana – kanta, veen habbaal ochel perot. tarte?!
La kashya; kan bemaot temunin, kan bemaot sheen temunin – deamar rav yehuda: maot temunin – lo kanta, maot sheenan temunin – kanta.

Tanu rabbanan: en mekabbelin pikdonot – lo min hannashim, velo min haavadim, velo min hattinokot. kibbel min haishsha – yachzir laishsha, veim meta – yachzir levalah. kibbel min haeved – yachzir laeved, veim met – yachzir lerabbo.

a: Kibbel min hakkatan – yaase lo segulla, veim met – yachazir leyorshav.
Vechullan sheamru bishat mitatan: "shel peloni hen", yaase keferushan. veim lav, yaase perush leferushan.
Devethu derabba bar bar chana, ki ka shachva, amara: "hane kefe, demarta uvene veratta". ata lekammeh derav, amar leh: i mehemna lach – ase keferushah, vei la – ase perush leferushah.
Veikka deamri, hachi amar leh: i amida lach, ase keferushah, vei la – ase perush leferushah.
Min hakkatan – yaase lo segulla. may "segulla"? rav chisda amar: sefer tora. rabba bar rav huna amar: dikla deachel minneh tamre.
Velo laav benichse habben, velo labben benichse haav. amar rav yosef: afillu chalku. rava amar: chalku – lo.

Amar rav yirmeya middifti: avad rav pappi ovada "chalku – lo", kerava. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, ishtai li rav chiyyay mehormiz ardeshir, deishtai leh rav acha bar yaakov, mishshemeh derav nachman bar yaakov: chalku lo. vehilcheta: chalku lo. tanya name hachi: ben shechalak, veishto shennitgarsha – hare hen kishar kol adam.

Ittemar: echad min haachin shehaya nose venoten betoch habbayit, vehayu onot ushetarot yotzin al shemo, veamar: shelli hem, shennaflu li mibbet avi imma – amar rav: alav lehavi reaya. ushemuel amar: al haachin lehavi reaya. amar shemuel: mode li abba, sheim met – al haachin lehavi reaya.
Matkef la rav pappa: kelum taaninan lehu leyatme, midde dela tean lehu avuhon? veha rava appek zuga desarbala vesifra deaggadta miyyatme, belo reaya, bidvarim haasuyim lehasheil ulehaskir –
b: Kedishlach rav huna bar avin: devarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir, veamar "lekuchin hen beyadi", eno neeman! kashya.
Amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella deen chalukin beissatan, aval chalukim beissatan – emor meissato kimmetz.
Reaya bemay? rabba amar: reaya beedim, rav sheshet amar: reaya bekiyyum hashshetar.

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: ha rav veha shemuel, ha rabba veha rav sheshet; mar –, keman sevira leh? amar leh: ana matnita yadana, detanya: echad min haachin shehaya noten venose betoch habbayit, vehayu onot ushetarot yotzin al shemo, veamar: shelli hen, shennaflu li mibbet avi imma – alav lehavi reaya.
Vechen haishsha shehi noset venotenet betoch habbayit, vehayu onot ushetarot yotzin al shemah, veamra: shelli hen, shennaflu li mibbet avi abba o mibbet avi imma – aleha lehavi reaya.
May "vechen"? mahu detema: ishsha, kevan dishvicha la milleta – deamri ka tarcha kamme yatme, la gazla miyyatme; ka mashma lan:.
Bamme devarim amurim – bemachzik, aval benoten mattana vehaachin shechalku vechulei. attu kol hane deamrinan, lav bene chazaka ninhu?
Chassore mechassera, vehachi katane: bamme devarim amurim – bachazaka sheyyesh immah taana, kegon mocher omer: "lo macharti", velokeach omer: "lakachti";
Aval chazaka sheen immah taana – kegon noten mattana, vehaachin shechalku, vehammachzik benichse hagger – dilmikne bealma hu; naal, gadar, paratz kol shehu – hare zo chazaka.

Tane rav hoshaya bekiddushin deve levi: naal, gadar, paratz kol shehu befanav – hare zo chazaka. befanav – in, shello befanav – la? amar rava, hachi kaamar: befanav – la tzerich lememar leh: "lech chazek ukeni",

a: Shello befanav – tzarich lememar leh: "lech chazek ukeni".

Bae rav: mattana – heach? amar shemuel: may tive leh leabba? hasheta uma mecher, deka yahev leh zuze, i amar leh: "lech chazek ukeni" – in, i la – la; mattana, lo kol shekken?! verav savar: man deyahev mattana, beayin yafa yahev.
Vechamma kol shehu? kedishmuel – deamar shemuel: gadar gader vehishlimo laasara, ufaratz pirtza kede sheyyikkanes veyetze bah – hare zo chazaka.

Hay gader hechi dame? illema demeikkara la havo salki la, vehasheta name la salki la – may avad? veella demeikkara havo salki la, vehasheta la salki la – tuva avad! la tzericha, demeikkara havo salki la beravvcha, vehasheta ka salki la beducheka.

Hay pirtza – hechi dame? illema demeikkara havo ayyli ba, vehasheta name ayyli ba – may avad? veella demeikkara la havo ayyli ba, vehasheta ka ayyli ba – tuva avad! la tzericha, demeikkara havo ayyli ba beducheka, vehasheta ayyli ba beravvcha.
Amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: natan tzeror vehoil, natal tzeror vehoil – hare zo chazaka. may "natan" umay "natal"?
Illema natan tzeror – usechar mayya minna, natal tzeror – veappek mayya minna; hay mavriach ari minnichse chavero hu! ella natan tzeror – detzammed la mayya, natal tzeror – vearvach la mayya.
Veamar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: shete sadot umetzer echad benehen, hechzik beachat mehen liknotah – kenaah.
b: Liknot otah veet chavertah – otah kana, chavertah lo kana. liknot et chavertah – af otah lo kana.
Bae rabbi zera: hechzik beachat mehen liknot otah, veet hammetzer, veet chavertah – mahu? mi amrinan: metzer deara chad hu, vekane; o dilma hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae? teku.
Bae rabbi elazar: hechzik bammetzer liknot shetehen, mahu? mi amrinan hay metzer – afsera deara hu, vekane; o dilma hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae? teku.

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: shene vattim ze lifnim mizze, hechzik bachitzon liknoto – kenao. liknot oto veet happenimi – chitzon kana, penimi lo kana. liknot et happenimi – af chitzon name lo kana.
Hechzik bappenimi liknoto – kenao. liknot oto veet hachitzon – kana shenehen. liknot et hachitzon – af penimi lo kana.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: habbone palterin gedolim benichse hagger, uva acher veheemid lahen delatot – kana. may tama? kamma – livne bealma hu daafech.
Amar rav dimi bar yosef amar rabbi elazar: hammotze palterin benichse hagger, vesad bahen siyyud echad o kiyyur echad – kenaan. vechamma? amar rav yosef: amma. amar rav chisda: ucheneged happetach.

Amar rav amram: hay milleta amar lan rav sheshet, veanharinhu aynin mimmatnita: hammatztzia matztzaot benichse hagger – kana. "veanharinhu aynin mimmatnita" – may hi? detanya: ketzad bachazaka? naal lo minalo, o hittir lo minalo, o sheholich kelav acharav levet hammerchatz, vehifshito, vehirchitzo, sacho, gerdo, vehilbisho, vehinilo, vehigbiho – kenao. amar rabbi shimon: lo tehe chazaka gedola mehagebaha – shehagebaha kona bechol makom.
May kaamar? hachi kaamar: higbiho lerabbo – kenao, higbiah rabbo lo – lo kenao. amar rabbi shimon: lo tehe chazaka gedola mehagebaha – shehagebaha kona bechol makom.
Amar rav yirmeya biraa amar rav yehuda: hay man

a: Dishda lifta be file deara deger – la have chazaka. may tama? beiddana dishda – la have shevacha, hasheta deka shavach – mimmela ka shavach.
Amar shemuel: hay man defashach dikla; addata dedikla – kane, addata dechevata – la kane. hechi dame? shekal mehay gisa umehay gisa – addata dedikla. kolla mechad gisa – addata dechevata.
Veamar shemuel: hay man dezache zichya; addata deara – kane, addata detzive – la kane. hechi dame? shekal ravreve vezutere – addata deara, shekal ravreve ushevak zutere – addata detzive.

Veamar shemuel: hay man detakel tikla; addata deara – kane, addata deve dare – la kane. hechi dame? shekal muleya usheda benatztza – addata deara. muleya bemuleya venatztza benatztza – addata deve dare.
Veamar shemuel: hay man defatach mayya beara; addata deara – kane, addata dechavvre – la kane. hechi dame? patach tere vave, chad meayyel vechad mappek – addata dechavvre. chad bava – addata deara.

Hahi itteta daachala dikla betafshicha, telesar shenin. ata hahu [gavra], rafek tuteh pureta. ata lekammeh delevi, veamri la kammeh demar ukeva, okmeh bideh. atay ka tzavvcha kammeh, amar la: may eeved lach, dela achzekt kidmachzeki inashe.
Amar rav: hatztzar tzura benichse hagger – kana; derav la kane leginneta deve rav, ella betzureta.
Ittemar: sade hamesuyyemet bimtzareha – amar rav huna amar rav: kevan shehikkish bah makkosh echad – kana kullah. ushemuel amar: lo kana ella mekom makkosho bilvad.
b: Vesheenah mesuyyemet bimtzareha, ad kamma? amar rav pappa: kidazel tayyayra deshore vehadar.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: nichse goy hare hen kemidbar, kol hammachzik bahen zacha bahen. may tama? goy – mikki matu zuze lideh istallak leh, yisrael la kane ad demate shetara lideh. hilkach hare hen kemidbar, vechol hammachzik bahen zacha bahen.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: mi amar shemuel hachi?! vehaamar shemuel: dina demalchuta dina; umalka amar: la likne ara ella beiggarta! amar leh: ana la yadana; ovada hava bedura deraavata, beyisrael dizvan ara miggoy, vaata yisrael acharina rafek bah pureta; ata lekammeh derav yehuda, okma bida desheni.
Amar leh: dura deraavata kaamrat?! hatam bage mittammeri havo – deinhu gufayyhu la havo yahavi taska lemalka, umalka amar: man deyahev taska, lechol ara.

Rav huna zeven ara miggoy, ata yisrael acher rafek ba pureta. ata lekammeh derav nachman, okma bideh. amar leh: may dataych? deamar shemuel: nichse goy hare hen kemidbar, vechol hammachzik bahem zacha?

a: Lebad li mar keiddach dishmuel, deamar shemuel: lo kana ella mekom makkosho bilvad! amar leh: behay, ana kishmatin sevira li – deamar rav huna amar rav: kevan shennikkesh bah makkosh echad – kana kullah.
Shelach rav huna bar avin: yisrael shellakach sade miggoy, uva yisrael acher vehechezik bah – en motziim otah miyyado. vechen haya rabbi avin verabbi ila vechol rabbotenu shavin baddavar.

Amar rabba: hane telat mille, ishtai li ukevan bar nechemya resh galuta, mishshemeh dishmuel: dina demalchuta dina, vaarisuta defarsae – ad arbein shenin, vehane zaharure dezaven ara letaska – zevinayhu zevine.
Vehane mille letaska, aval lichraga – la. may tama? keraga – akkarkaf degavre mannach. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: afillu seare dechadda mishtabedi lichraga.
Amar rav ashe: amar li huna bar natan, kashe ba ammemar: im ken, bittalta yerushshat beno habbechor – dehave leh rauy, veen habbechor notel barauy kevammuchezak.
Amri leh: i hachi, afillu taska name! ella ma it lach lememar – dihayv taska umit; hacha name – dihayv keraga umit.
Amar rav ashe, amar li huna bar natan: sheeltinhu lesafre derava, vaamaru li: hilcheta kerav huna bereh derav yehoshua. vela hi, hatam – leokome milleteh hu deamar.
Veamar rav ashe: pardacht – mesayyay mata. vehane mille deatztzelteh mata, aval andiske – siyyata dishmayya hi.
Amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: hammetzer vehechatzav mafsikin benichse hagger, aval leinyan pea vetumea – la. ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: afillu lefea vetumea.
Pea – may hi? ditnan: veellu mafsikin lappea – hannachal, vehashshelulit,
b: Vederech harabbim, vederech hayyachid, ushevil harabbim, ushevil hayyachid hakkavua ben bimot hachamma uven bimot haggeshamim.

Tumea – may hi? ditnan: hannichnas levika bimot haggeshamim, vetumea besade pelonit, veamar: halachti lammakom hallaz, veeni yodea im nichnasti leoto makom veim lav – rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammein.
Shehaya rabbi eliezer omer: sefek bia – tahor, sefek magga tumea – tame.
Aval leshabbat lo.
Rava amar: afillu leinyan shabbat, detanya: hotzi chatzi gerogeret lirshut harabbim vehinnicha, vechazar vehotzi chatzi gerogeret acheret; behelem echad – chayyayv. bishne helemot – patur.
Rabbi yose omer: behelem echad;

a: Birshut achat – chayyayv, bishte reshuyot – patur.
Veamar rabba: vehu sheyyesh chiyyuv chattat benehem, aval karmelit – lo. abbaye amar: afillu karmelit, aval pisla – lo. rava amar: afillu pisla.
Veazda rava letameh, deamar rava: reshut shabbat kirshut gittin dame.
En sham lo metzer velo chatzav, may? peresh rabbi marinus mishshemo: kol shennikret al shemo. hechi dame? amar rav pappa: dekaru leh "be garguta diflanya".
Yatev rav acha bar avya kammeh derabbi assi, veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derabbi assi bar chanina: chatzuva mafsek benichse hagger.
May chatzuva? amar rav yehuda amar rav: shebbo tichem yehoshua leyisrael et haaretz.
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: lo mana yehoshua ella ayayrot haomdot al haggevulin.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol sheherahu hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe – chayyayv bemaaser.
Leappoke may? leappoke keni, kenizzi vekadmoni. tanya, rabbi meir omer: naftocha, arvaa veshalmaa. rabbi yehuda omer: har seir, ammon umoav. rabbi shimon omer: ardisakis, asya veaspamya.
Mishna hayu shenayim meidin oto sheachalah shalosh shanim, venimtzeu zommim – meshallemin lo et hakkol. shenayim barishona, shenayim bashsheniyya, ushenayim bashshelishit –
b: Meshalleshin benehem.
Shelosha achim, veechad mitztaref immahem – hare ellu shalosh eduyot, vehen edut achat lahazama.

Gemara matnitin dela kerabbi akiva – detanya, amar rabbi yose: keshehalach abba chalafta etzel rabbi yochanan ben nuri lilmod tora, veamri la: rabbi yochanan ben nuri etzel abba chalafta lilmod tora, amar lo: hare sheachalah shana rishona bifne shenayim, sheniyya bifne shenayim, shelishit bifne shenayim – mahu? amar lo: hare zo chazaka.
Amar lo: af ani omer ken, ella sherabbi akiva cholek bedavar ze; shehaya rabbi akiva omer: "davar" – velo chatzi davar.
Verabbanan – hay "davar" velo chatzi davar, may avdi leh? illema lemaote echad omer achat begabbah veechad omer achat bichresah; hay chatzi davar vachatzi edut hi!
Ella lemaote shenayim omrim achat begabbah, ushenayim omrim achat bichresah.

Amar rav yehuda: echad omer achalah chittim, veechad omer achalah seorim – hare zo chazaka. matkef la rav nachman: ella meatta, echad omer: achalah rishona shelishit vachamishit, veechad omer: achalah sheniyya reviit veshishshit, hachi name dehavya chazaka?!
Amar leh rav yehuda: hachi hasheta?! hatam, beshatta deka mashed mar – la ka mashed mar; hacha, tarvayyhu bachada shatta ka mashadi. may ikka lememar – ben chitte lisare? lav addatayyhu deinashe.
Shelosha achin, veechad mitztaref immahen – hare ellu shalosh eduyot, vehen edut achat lahazama.

a: Hahu shetara dahava chatimi aleh be tere, shachev chad minnayyhu. ata achu dehay dekae, vechad acharina, leashode achatimat yedeh deiddach.
Sevar ravina lememar: hayeynu matnitin – shelosha achin, veechad mitztaref immahen.
Amar leh rav ashe: mi dame?! hatam la nafek neche riva demamona appumma deache, hacha nafek neche riva demamona appumma deache.

Mishna ellu devarim sheyyesh lahen chazaka, veellu devarim sheen lahen chazaka? haya maamid behema bechatzer; tannur, rechayim vechirayim; umegaddel tarnegolim; venoten zivlo bechatzer – enah chazaka. aval asa mechitza livhemto – gavoah asara tefachim, vechen lattannur vechen lakkirayim vechen larechayim; hichnis tarnegolin letoch habbayit; veasa makom lezivlo – amok shelosha o gavoah shelosha; hare zo chazaka.
Gemara may shena resha, umay shena sefa?
Amar ulla: kol sheillu benichse hagger kana – benichse chavero kana, kol sheillu benichse hagger lo kana – benichse chavero lo kana.
Matkef la rav sheshet: uchelala hu?! vahare nir – divnichse hagger kana, benichse chavero lo kana! vahare achilat perot – divnichse chavero kana, benichse hagger lo kana!
Ella amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu:
b: Hacha bachatzar hashshuttafin askinan – divhaamada kedi la kafdi, ammechitza kafdi.
Uvehaamada kedi la kafdi?! veha tenan: hashshuttafin shennadru hanaa ze mizze – asurin likkanes lechatzer!
Ella amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hacha birchava shel achore vattim askinan; divhaamada kedi la kafdi, veammechitza kafdi.
Rav pappa amar: idde veidde bachatzar hashshuttafin; veikka dekafdi veikka dela kafdi; gabbe mamona – lekulla, gabbe issura – lechumera.
Ravina amar: leolam la kafdi, veha manni – rabbi eliezer hi; detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: afillu vittur asur bemuddar hanaa.
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi benaa: bakkol shuttafin meakkevin ze et ze, chutz min hakkevisa – sheen darkan shel benot yisrael lehitbazzot al hakkevisa.
"Veotzem enav merot bera" – amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: ze sheen mistakkel benashim beshaa sheomdot al hakkevisa.
Hechi dame? i deikka darka achrita – rasha hu! i delekka darka achrita – anus hu! leolam delekka darka achrita, vaafillu hachi – mibbee leh lemenas nafsheh.

Bea minneh rabbi yochanan merabbi benaa: chaluk shel talmid chacham – ketzad? kol sheen besaro nire mittachtav. tallit shel talmid chacham – ketzad? kol sheen chaluko nire mittachtav tefach. shulchan shel talmid chacham – ketzad? shene shelishe gedil, ushelish gelay – vealav kearot veyarak. vetabbato mibbachutz.
Veha tanya: tabbato mibbifnim! la kashya – ha deikka yanoka, ha delekka yanoka.
Vei baet ema: ha veha delekka yanoka; vela kashya – ha deikka shammaa, ha delekka shammaa.
Vei baet ema: ha veha deikka shammaa; vela kashya – ha bimama, ha belelya.
Veshel am haaretz – dome

a: Limdura, ukederot makkifot otah.
Mitta shel talmide chachamim – ketzad? kol sheen tachteha ella sandalin bimot hachamma, uminalin bimot haggeshamim. veshel am haaretz – doma leotzar balus.

Rabbi benaa hava ka metzayyen mearata. ki meta limarta deavraham, ashkecheh leeliezer eved avraham dekae kamme bava. amar leh: may ka aved avraham? amar leh: gane bechanfa desara, veka meayyeyna leh beresheh.
Amar leh, zil ema leh: benaa kae abbava. amar leh: leul – midda yedia deyetzer behay alma lekka. ayel, ayyen unefak.

Ki meta limarta deadam harishon, yatzta bat kol veamra: "nistakkalta bidmut deyokni, bidyokni atzmah al tistakkel". "ha baena letzayyone mearta!" "kemiddat hachitzona kach middat happenimit. uleman deamar shene vattim zo lemala mizzo – kemiddat elyona kach middat hattachtona".

Amar rabbi benaa: nistakkalti bishne akevav, vedomim lishne galgalle chamma. hakkol bifne sara – kekof bifne adam. sara bifne chavva – kekof bifne adam. chavva bifne adam – kekof bifne adam. adam bifne shechina – kekof bifne adam.
Shufereh derav kahana meen shufereh derav, shufereh derav meen shufereh derabbi avahu, shufereh derabbi avahu meen shufereh deyaakov avinu, shufereh deyaakov avinu meen shufereh deadam harishon.

Hahu amgusha dahava chatet shachve. ki meta ammearta derav tovi bar matna, tafseh bedikneh. ata abbaye, amar leh: bematuta minnach, shivkeh. leshana achariti hadar ata, tafseh bedikneh. ata abbaye, la shivkeh ad deayyti maspera vegazzeye ledikneh.

Hahu daamar lehu: chavita deafra lechad beray, chavita degarme lechad beray, chavita deudera lechad beray. la havo yadi may kaamar lehu. ato lekammeh derabbi benaa, amar lehu: "it lechu ara?" amaru leh: "in". "it lechu chevata?" "in". "it lechu bistarke?" "in". "i hachi, hachi kaamar lechu".
Hahu gavra deshama lidvethu deka amra levarta: "ammay la tzenniat beissura? hach itteta, asara bene it la, velet li meavuch ella chad". ki shachev, amar lehu: "kol nichsay lechad bera".

La yadi lehe minnayyhu. ato lekammeh derabbi benaa, amar lehu: zilu chavutu kivra daavuchon, ad dekae umegalle lechu lehe minnayychu shevako. azalu kullehu, hahu divreh hava la azal. amar lehu: kullehu nichse dehay. azalu achalu kuratza be malka, amri: ikka gavra chad bihudae, deka mappek mamona meinashe bela sahadi uvela midde. atyuhu chavshuhu.
Azala devethu, amara lehu: avda chad hava li, pesaku leresheh ufeshatu lemashkeh vaachalu bisreh, veka malu beh mayya umashku beh lechavrayyay, vela ka yahavi li deme vela agreh.
La yadi may ka amra lehu. amri: nayto lechakkima dihudae, velema. karyuhu lerabbi benaa, amar lehu: zarnuka amra lechu. amri: hoil vechakkim kulle hay, littev abbava venedun dina.
Chaza dahava ketiv baavulla: "kol dayyayn demitkere ledin – la shemeh dayyayn". amar lehu: ella meatta, ata inish mealma
b: Umazmen (lehu) [leh] ledina, pasleh?! ella kol dayyayn demitkere ledin, umappekin minneh mamona bedin – lav shemeh dayyayn. ketavu hachi: "beram save dihudae amri: kol dayyayn demitkere ledin umappekin minneh mamona bedin – lav shemeh dayyayn".

Chaza dichtiv: "beresh kol mota – ana dam, beresh kol chayyin – ana chamar". ella meatta, denafel meiggara umit, udenafel middikla umit, dema katleh?! vetu, man dedarkeh lememat – mashku leh chamra, vechaye?! ella hachi bae lemichtav: beresh kol marin – ana dam, beresh kol asvon – ana chamar. ketavu hachi: "beram save dihudae amri: beresh kol marin – ana dam, beresh kol asvon – ana chamar, baatar delet chamar – tamman mitbau sammanin".
Ketiv appitcha dekappotkeya: "anpak, anbag, antal". veezehu antal? zehu reviit shel tora.
Mishna hammarzev en lo chazaka, veyesh limkomo chazaka. hammazchela yesh lah chazaka.
Sullam hammitzri en lo chazaka, velatztzori yesh lo chazaka.

Challon hammitzrit en lah chazaka, velatztzorit yesh lah chazaka. ezo hi challon hammitzrit? kol sheen rosho shel adam yachol likkanes letochah. rabbi yehuda omer: im yesh lah malben – af al pi sheen rosho shel adam yachol likkanes letochah, hare zo chazaka.
Gemara may "hammarzev en lo chazaka, veyesh limkomo chazaka"? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, hachi kaamar: hammarzev en lo chazaka – meruach achat, veyesh limkomo chazaka – mishte ruchot.
Rabbi chanina amar: hammarzev en lo chazaka – sheim haya aroch mekatztzero, veyesh limkomo chazaka – sheim ba leokro, eno okro.
Rav yirmeya bar abba amar: hammarzev en lo chazaka – sheim rotze livnot tachtav bone, veyesh limkomo chazaka – sheim ba leokro eno okro.

a: Tenan: "hammazchela yesh lah chazaka". bishlama leman deamar hanach tarte – shappir.
Ella leman deamar sheim ratza livnot tachtav bone, may nafka leh minna?
Hacha bemazchela shel binyan askinan, deamar leh: la nicha li detittera ashitay.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: tzinnor hamekalleach mayim lachatzar chavero, uva baal haggag lesotmo, baal hechatzer meakkev alav, daamar leh: ki hechi deat kanya lach chatzer didi lemishde beh mayya, ledidi name kene li mayya deiggarach.

Ittemar, rabbi oshaya amar: meakkev. rabbi chama, amar: eno meakkev. azal shayyleh lerabbi besa, amar lehu: meakkev. kare aleh rame bar chama: "vehachut hameshullash lo vimhera yinnatek" – ze rabbi oshaya beno shel rabbi chama beno shel rabbi besa.
Sullam hammitzri en lo chazaka. hechi dame sullam hammitzri? amri deve rabbi yannay: kol sheen lo arbaa chavokin.
Challon hammitzrit en lah chazaka kulei. may shena gabbe sullam dela mefaresh, umay shena gabbe challon dimfaresh? mishshum deka bae ippeloge rabbi yehuda besefa.

Amar rabbi zera: lematta mearba ammot – yesh lo chazaka, veyachol lemachot; lemala mearba ammot – en lo chazaka, veeno yachol lemachot. verabbi ila amar: afillu lemala mearba ammot – en lo chazaka, veyachol lemachot.
Lema bechofin al middat sedom ka mippalgi – demar savar: kofin, umar savar: en kofin?

La; dechulle alma kofin, veshane hacha – daamar leh: zimnin demotvat sharshifa tutach, vekayymat veka chazet. hahu daata lekammeh derabbi amme. shaddereh lekammeh derabbi abba bar memel, amar leh: aved leh kerabbi ila.
Amar shemuel: uleora – afillu kol shehu yesh lo chazaka.
Mishna hazziz; ad tefach – yesh lo chazaka,
b: Veyachol lemachot. pachot mittefach – en lo chazaka, veen yachol lemachot.

Gemara amar rabbi assi amar rabbi mani, veamri lah amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi mani: hechzik betefach – hechzik bearba. may kaamar? amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: hechzik rochav tefach bemeshech arba – hechzik berochav arba.

Pachot mittefach – en lo chazaka, veeno yachol lemachot. amar rav huna: lo shanu ella baal haggag bevaal hechatzer, aval baal hechatzer bevaal haggag – yachol lemachot. verav yehuda amar: afillu baal chatzer bevaal haggag, eno yachol lemachot.
Lema behezzek reiyya kamippalgi – demar savar: shemeh hezzek, umar savar: lav shemeh hezzek?
La; dechulle alma shemeh hezzek; veshane hacha, deamar leh: letashmishta – la chaze; lemay chaze – lemitle beh midde; mahdarna appay vetalena beh.
Veiddach – amar leh: zimnin divitat.

Mishna lo yiftach adam challonotav lachatzar hashshuttafin. lakach bayit bechatzer acheret – lo yiftachenna bachatzar hashshuttafin. bana aliyyay al gabbe beto – lo yiftachenna lachatzar hashshuttafin; ella im ratza – bone et hacheder lefanim mibbeto, uvone aliyyay al gabbe beto, ufotchah letoch beto.
Gemara may irya lachatzar hashshuttafin? afillu lachatzar chavero name la!

La mibbaya kaamar – la mibbaya lachatzar chavero dela, aval lachatzar hashshuttafin, deamar leh: sof sof ha ka baet itztenoe minnay bechatzer; ka mashma lan daamar leh: ad haiddana – bechatzer hava baena itztenoe minnach, hasheta – afillu babbayit name baena itztenoe minnach.

Tanu rabbanan: maase beadam echad sheppatach challonav lachatzar hashshuttafin; uva lifne rabbi yishmael bar rabbi yose, amar lo: hechzakta beni, hechzakta; uva lifne rabbi chiyyay, amar: yagata ufatachta, yega usetom.
Amar rav nachman:

a: Velistom – lealtar have chazaka, sheen adam asuy shessotmim oro befanav veshotek.
Lakach bayit bechatzer acheret – lo yiftachennu lachatzar hashshuttafin. may tama? mippene shemmarbe alehem et hadderech.
Ema sefa: ella im ratza – bone et hacheder lifnim mibbeto, uvone aliyyay al gabbe beto. vahalo marbe alav et hadderech! amar rav huna: may cheder? shechalako bishnayim, umay aliyyay? appetay.

Mishna lo yiftach adam lachatzar hashshuttafin petach keneged petach vechallon keneged challon. haya katan – lo yaasennu gadol, echad – lo yaasennu shenayim. aval poteach hu lirshut harabbim petach keneged petach vechallon keneged challon. haya katan – ose oto gadol, veechad – ose oto shenayim.

Gemara menahane mille? amar rabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "vayyissa vilam et enav, vayyar et yisrael shochen lishvatav" – ma raa? raa sheen pitche oholehem mechuuonin ze leze, amar: reuyin hallalu shettishre alehem shechina.

Haya katan – lo yaasennu gadol. savar rame bar chama lememar, bar arbee la lishavveyeh bar temanya – deka shakel temanya bechatzer; aval bar tarte lishavveyeh bar arbee – shappir dame; amar leh rava, matze amar leh: befitcha zutera matzena leitztenoe minnach, befitcha rabba la matzena itztenoe minnach.

Echad – lo yaasennu shenayim. savar rame bar chama lememar, bar arbee – la lishavveyeh tere bene tarte tarte, deka shakel tamne bechatzer; aval bar tamne, lishavveyeh bene arbee arbee – shappir dame; amar leh rava, matze amar leh: bechad pitcha matzena itztenoe minnach, bitre la matzena itztenoe minnach.
Aval poteach hu lirshut harabbim petach keneged petach. deamar leh: sof sof, ha baet itztenoe mibbene reshut harabbim.

Mishna en osin chalal tachat reshut harabbim – borot, shichin umearot. rabbi eliezer mattir kede shettehe agala mehallechet uteuna avanim. en motziin zizin ugezuzetraot lirshut harabbim, ella im ratza – kones letoch shello, umotzi. lakach chatzer uvah zizin ugezuzetraot – hare zo bechezkatah.
Gemara verabbanan – zimnin demippechit velav addateh.

En motziin zizin ugezuzetraot vechulei. rabbi amme hava leh ziza dahava nafek limvoa; vehahu gavra name hava leh ziza, dahava mappek lirshut harabbim. havo ka meakkevi aleh bene reshut harabbim. ata lekammeh derabbi amme, amar leh: zil kotz.
Amar leh: veha mar name it leh! didi limvoa mappek – bene mevoa machalin gabbay; didach lirshut harabbim mappek, man machel gabbach?

Rabbi yannay hava leh ilan hannote lirshut harabbim. hava hahu gavra dahava leh name ilan hannote lirshut harabbim, ato bene reshut harabbim havo ka meakkevi illaveh. ata lekammeh derabbi yannay, amar leh:
b: Zil haiddana veta limchar. belelya, shaddar katzyeh lehahu dideh.
Limchar ata lekammeh, amar leh: zil kotz. amar leh: ha mar name it leh! amar leh: zil chazi; i kutz didi – kotz didach, i la kutz didi – la tikkotz at.

Meikkara may sevar ulevassof may sevar? meikkara sevar: nicha lehu livne reshut harabbim, deyatvi betulleh. kevan dachaza deka meakkevi, shaddar katzyeh. velema leh: zil kotz didach, vahadar ekkotz didi! mishshum deresh lakish, deamar: "hitkoshshu vakoshshu" – keshot atzmecha veachar kach keshot acherim.
Aval im ratza – kones letoch shello umotzi. ibbaya lehu: kanas velo hotzi, mahu sheyyachazor veyotzi? rabbi yochanan amar: kanas – motzi. veresh lakish amar: kanas – eno motzi.

Amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa, asbera lach: lehotzi – kulle alma la peligi demotzi, ki peligi – lehachazir ketalim limkoman; veippecha ittemar – rabbi yochanan amar: eno machzir, veresh lakish amar: machzir.

Rabbi yochanan amar: eno machzir – mishshum derav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda: metzer shehecheziku bo rabbim, asur lekalkelo. veresh lakish amar: machzir – hane mille hecha delekka ravvcha, hacha ha ikka ravvcha.
Lakach chatzer uvah zizin ugezuzetraot – hare hi bechezkatah. amar rav huna: nafla, chozer uvone otah.
Metivi: en mesayyeydin veen mechayyeyrin veen mefayyeychin bazzeman hazze. lakach chatzer mesuyyedet, mechuyyeret, mefuyyachat – hare zo bechezkatah. nafla – eno chozer uvone otah!
Issura shane.
Tanu rabbanan: lo yasud adam et beto besid. veim erav bo chol o teven – muttar. rabbi yehuda omer: erav bo chol – hare ze terachsid, veasur; teven – muttar.

Tanu rabbanan: keshecharav habbayit bashsheniyya, rabbu perushin beyisrael shello leechol basar veshello lishtot yayin. nitpal lahen rabbi yehoshua, amar lahen: banay, mippene ma i attem ochlin basar veen attem shotin yayin? amru lo: nochal basar – shemmimmennu makrivin al gabbe mizbeach, veachshav batel? nishte yayin – shemmenassechin al gabbe hammizbeach, veachshav batel?

Amar lahem: im ken, lechem lo nochal – shekkevar batlu menachot! efshar beferot. perot lo nochal – shekkevar batlu bikkurim! efshar beferot acherim. mayim lo nishte – shekkevar batel nissuch hammayim! shatku.

Amar lahen: banay, bou veomar lachem: shello lehitabbel kol ikkar i efshar – shekkevar nigzera gezera; ulehitabbel yoter midday i efshar – sheen gozrin gezera al hatztzibbur, ella im ken rov tzibbur yecholin laamod bah – dichtiv: "bammeera attem nearim, veoti attem kovim; haggoy kullo" –
Ella kach amru chachamim: sad adam et beto besid, umeshayyer bo davar muat; vechamma? amar rav yosef: amma al amma. amar rav chisda: keneged happetach.
Ose adam kol tzorche seuda, umeshayyer davar muat; may hi? amar rav pappa: kasa deharsana.
Osa ishsha kol tachshiteha, umeshayyeret davar muat; may hi? amar rav: bat tzida. shenneemar: "im eshkachech yerushalam, tishkach yemini. tidbak leshoni lechikki vegomer".

May "al rosh simchati"? amar rav yitzchak: ze efer mikle shebberosh chatanim. amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: hecha mannach le? bimkom tefillin, shenneemar: "lasum laavele tziyyon, latet lahem peer tachat efer".
Vechol hammitabbel al yerushalayim – zoche veroe besimchatah, shenneemar: "simchu et yerushalami vegomer".

Tanya, amar rabbi yishmael ben elisha: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash, din hu shennigzor al atzmenu shello leechol basar velo lishtot yayin; ella en gozrin gezera al hatztzibbur ella im ken rov tzibbur yecholin laamod bah.

Umiyyom sheppashta malchut harshaa, sheggozeret alenu gezerot raot vekashot, umevattelet mimmennu tora umitzvot, veen mannachat otanu likkanes lishvua habben, veamri la: lishua habben; din hu shennigzor al atzmenu shello lissa ishsha uleholid banim, venimtza zaro shel avraham avinu kale meelav;
Ella hannach lahem leyisrael – mutav sheyyihyu shoggin, veal yihyu mezidin.
Haderan alach chezkat habbattim

a: Hammocher et habbayit – lo machar yatzia, veaf al pi shehi petucha letocho; velo et hacheder shellefanim hemennu; velo et haggag – bizman sheyyesh lo maake gavoah asara tefachim. rabbi yehuda omer: im yesh lo tzurat petach, af al pi sheeno gavoah asara tefachim – eno machur.

Gemara may "yatzia"? hacha targimu: appeta. rav yosef amar: badka chalila. leman deamar appeta la mizdabbena – kol shekken badka chalila la mizdabbena; leman deamar badka chalila – aval appeta mizdabbena.

Tane rav yosef: shalosh shemot yesh lo – yatzia, tzela, ta. yatzia – dichtiv: "hayyatzia hattachtona chamesh baamma rochbah". tzela – dichtiv: "vehatztzelaot tzela el tzela shalosh usheloshim peamim". ta – dichtiv: "vehatta kane echad orech vekane echad rochav, uven hattaim chamesh ammot". vei baet ema, mehacha: "kotel hahechol shesh, vehatta shesh, kotel hatta chamesh".
Amar mar zutera: vehu dehave arba ammot.

Amar leh ravina lemar zutera: ledidach deamrat ad dehave arba ammot; ella meatta, gabbe vor ditnan: lo et habbor velo et haddut – af al pi shekkatav lo umeka veruma; hachi name i havu arba ammot – in, i la – la?
Hachi hasheta?! hatam – ha tashmishta lechud, veha tashmishta lechud; hacha – idde veidde chada tashmishta hi; i have arba ammot – chashiv, vei la – la chashiv.
Velo et hacheder shellifnim hemennu. hasheta yatzia la mizdabban, cheder mibbaya?!
b: La tzericha, deaf al gav dimtzar leh mitzre abbaray –
Kidrav nachman, deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hammocher bayit lachavero bevira gedola, af al pi shemmatzar lo metzarim hachitzonim – metzarim hirchiv lo.
Hechi dame? illema dekaru leh levayit "bayit" ulevira "bira", peshita – bayit zabben leh, bira la zabben leh! ella dilvira name karu la "bayit"? kulleh zabben leh!

La tzericha, derubba karu leh levayit "bayit" levira "bira", veikka name dilvira karu leh "bayit"; mahu detema kulleh zabben leh, ka mashma lan – middahava leh lemichtav: "vela shayyayrit bizvini illen kelum", vela ketav, shema minna shayyore shayyayr.
Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hammocher sade lachavero bevika gedola, af al pi shemmatzar lo metzarim hachitzonim – metzarim hirchiv lo.
Hechi dame? illema dekaru leh lesade "sade" ulevika "bika", peshita – sade zabben leh, bika la zabben leh! veella dilvika name karu la "sade"? kullah zabben leh!

La tzericha, deikka dilsade karu leh "sade" ulevika "bika", veikka name dilvika karu la "sade"; mahu detema kulleh zabben leh, ka mashma lan – middahava leh lemichtav leh: "la shayyayrit bizvine illen kodamay kelum", vela ketav leh, shema minna shayyore shayyayr.
Utzericha; dei ashmeinan bayit – mishshum deha tashmishta lechod veha tashmishta lechod, aval bika – dechulla chada tashmishta hi, ema kulleh zabben leh;
Vei ashmeinan bika – mishshum dela hava leh lemimtzar leh, aval bayit – dahava leh lemimtzar leh vela metzar leh, kulleh zabben leh; tzericha.

Keman azla ha deamar rav mari bereh devat shemuel (bar shilat) mishshemeh deabbaye: hay man dimzabbeni leh midde lechavreh, tzerich lemichtav leh: "la shayyayrit bizvini illen kodamay kelum", keman? kerav nachman amar rabba bar avu.
Hahu deamar leh lechavreh: "ara deve chiyyay mezabbenna lach". havay leh tarte arata dahava mitkaryan "deve chiyyay". amar rav ashe: chada amar leh, tarte la amar leh.

Vei amar leh: "arata" setama – miut arata shetayim. vei amar leh: "kol arata" – kol arata deit leh, levar mibbusetane ufardese. vei amar leh: "zihara" – afillu be vusetane ufardese, levar mibbatte veavde.

a: Vei amar le: "nichse" – afillu batte veavde.
Matzar lo metzer echad aroch umetzer echad katzar – amar rav: lo kana ella keneged hakkatzar.
Amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: veyikne keneged rosh tor! shetek rav.

Umode rav, hecha deikka metzer reuven veshimon mechad gisa, umetzer levi vihuda mechad gisa; middahava leh lemichtav leh diruven keneged levi udeshimon keneged yehuda, vela ketav leh; shema minna keneged rosh tor hu daamar leh.
Metzer reuven mizrach umaarav, umetzer shimon tzafon vedarom – tzerich lemichtav leh: "metzer reuven ruchin teren, umetzer shimon ruchin teren".
Ibbaya lehu: siyyem lo et hakkeranot, mahu? kemin gam, mahu?
b: Beserugin, mahu? teku.

Matzar lo metzer rishon umetzer sheni umetzer shelishi, umetzer revii lo matzar lo – amar rav: kana hakkol, chutz mimmetzer revii. ushemuel amar: afillu metzer revii. verav assi amar: lo kana ella telem echad al pene kullah –
Savar la kerav, deamar: shayyore shayyayr; umiddeshayyayr bemetzer, shayyayr name bechullehi.
Amar rava, hilcheta: kana hakkol chutz mimmetzer revii. vela amaran ella dela mavla, aval mavla – kana.

Vechi la mavla name la amaran ella deikka aleh richba dedikla, vehave tishat kabbin; aval lekka aleh richba dedikla, vela have tishat kabbin – kana. mikkelal dechi muvela – af al gav deikka aleh richba dedikla, vehave tishat kabbin – kana.
Ikka deamri: amar rava, hilcheta: kana hakkol vaafillu metzer revii. vela amaran ella demavla, aval la mavla – la kene.

Vechi mavla name la amaran ella delekka aleh richba dedikla, vela have tishat kabbin; aval ikka aleh richba dedikla, vehave tishat kabbin – lo kana. mikkelal dechi la muvela – af al gav delekka aleh richba dedikla, vela have tishat kabbin – la kane.

Shaminan mittarvayyhu lishshane derava, divsade la shayyayr vela midde. veshaminan name, dehecha demavla, velekka aleh richba dedikla, vela have tishat kabbin – kana. la mavla, veikka aleh richba dedikla, vehave tishat kabbin – lo kana.
Mavla veikka aleh; la mavla velekka aleh – ittemar la lehay gisa, veittemar la lehay gisa. shuda dedayyayne.
Amar rabba: "palga deit li beara" – palga. "palga beara deit li" – riva. amar leh abbaye: may shena hachi umay shena hachi? ishtik.
Amar abbaye, ana savri: middeishtik – kabbole kabbela. vela hi; chazena hanhu shetare denafki mibbe mar, uchetiv behu hachi: "palga deit li beara" – palga, "palga beara deit li" – riva.
Veamar rabba: "metzer ara deminna palga" – palga. "metzer ara deminna pesika" – tisha kabbin.
Amar leh abbaye: may shena hachi umay shena hachi? ishtik. sevur minna, idde veidde palga;

a: Vela hi, deamar rav yemar bar shelemya: ledidi mipparsha li minneh deabbaye: ben "metzer ara deminna palga", uven "metzer ara deminna pesika" – i amar leh: "illen mitzranaha" – palga, la amar leh: "illen mitzranaha" – tisha kabbin.
Peshita – amar: "yachalok peloni binchasay" – palga. "tenu chelek lifloni binchasay" – may?

Amar ravina bar kisi, ta shema: detanya, haomer: "tenu chelek lifloni bevor" – somchos omer: en pachot mervia. "lechavit" – en pachot mishsheminit. "likdera" – en pachot mishshenem asar. "letafiach" – en pachot mishshishsha asar.
Tanu rabbanan: ben levi shemmachar sade leyisrael, veamar lo: "al menat shemmaaser rishon shelli" – maaser rishon shello. veim amar: "li ulevanayy" – met, yitten levanav.
Veim amar lo: "kol zeman shehassade zo beyadcha" – mecharah vechazar ulekachah, en lo alav kelum.
Ammay? en adam makne davar shello ba laolam! kevan deamar leh: "al menat shemmaaser rishon shelli" – shayyore shayyeyreh limkom maaser.
Amar resh lakish: zot omeret, hammocher bayit lachavero, veamar lo: "al menat sheddeyota haelyona shelli" – deyota haelyona shello.
b: Lemay hilcheta? rav zevid amar: sheim ratza lehotzi bah zizin, motzi. rav pappa amar: sheim ratza livnot aliyyay al gabbah, bone.
Bishlama lerav zevid, hayeynu dekatane "zot omeret"; ella lerav pappa, may "zot omeret"? kashya.

Amar rav dimi minnehardea: hay man dimzabben leh beta lechavreh, af al gav dichtav leh: "umeka veruma", tzarich lemichtav leh: "keni lach mittehom ara vead rum rekia". may tama? deumeka veruma bistama la kane; ahani "umeka veruma" lemikne umeka veruma, veahani "mittehom ara vead rum rekia" lemikne bor vadut umechillot.

Lema mesayyay leh: velo et habbor velo et haddut – af al pi shekkatav lo "umeka veruma". vei salka datach bistama kane umeka veruma, layhane "umeka veruma" lemikne bor vadut umechillot! dela ketav leh.

Veha "af al pi shekkatav lo" katane! hachi kaamar: af al pi shello katav lo, kemi shekkatav dame – lemikne umeka veruma. lemikne bor vadut umechillot – i ketav leh: "umeka veruma" – kane, vei la katav – la kane.
Ta shema: velo et haggag – bizman sheyyesh lo maake gavoah asara tefachim.

a: Vei salka datach bistama kane umeka veruma, ki gavoah asara tefachim may have? kevan degavoah asara tefachim – chashiv.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe, ta shema: deamar resh lakish, zot omeret: hammocher bayit lachavero, veamar lo: "al menat sheddeyota haelyona shelli" – deyota haelyona shello. veamrinan, lemay hilcheta? rav zevid amar: sheim ratza lehotzi bah zizin – motzi. rav pappa amar: sheim ratza livnot aliyyay al gabbah – bone.
Vei salka datach: bistama la kane, lema li "al menat"? ahani leh "al menat" – dei nafel, hadar bane lah.
Mishna lo et habbor velo et haddut – af al pi shekkatav lo umeka veruma. vetzarich likkach lo derech, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich likkach lo derech.
Umode rabbi akiva bizman sheamar lo "chutz meellu", sheen tzarich likkach derech.
Mecharan leacher – rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich likkach lo derech, vachachamim omrim: tzarich likkach lo derech.

Gemara yetev ravina veka kashya leh: hayeynu bor – hayeynu dut! amar leh rava tosfaa leravina: ta shema, detanya: echad habbor veechad haddut – bekarka, ella shehabbor bachafira vehaddut bevinyan. yatev rav ashe veka kashya leh: hayeynu bor – hayeynu dut! amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe: ta shema, detanya: echad habbor veechad haddut – bakkarka, ella shehabbor bachafira vehaddut bevinyan.
Vetzarich likkach lo derech, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich vechulei. may, lav beha ka mippalgi –
b: Derabbi akiva savar: mocher beayin yafa mocher, verabbanan savri: mocher beayin raa mocher; udekaamar name bealma "rabbi akiva letameh, deamar mocher beayin yafa mocher" – mehacha.
Mimmay? dilma rabbi akiva savar: en adam rotze sheyyitten meotav veyidresuhu acherim, verabbanan savri: en adam rotze sheyyittol maot veyifrach baavir!
Veella missefa – mecharan leacher, rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich likkach lo derech, vachachamim omrim: tzarich.
Dilma behay peligi – derabbi akiva savar: batar data delokeach azlinan; verabbanan savri: batar data democher azlinan!
Ella meha – la et habbor velo et haggat velo et hashshovach, ben charevin ben yeshuvin; vetzarich likkach lo derech, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich.
Ha tu lema li? ella lav ha ka mashma lan – derabbi akiva savar: mocher beayin yafa mocher, verabbanan savri: mocher beayin raa mocher?
Vedilma ashmeinan bayit, veka mashma lan sade; utzericha, dei ashmeinan bayit – mishshum devae tzeniuta, aval sade – ema la;
Vei ashmeinan sade – mishshum dekashe leh davvsha; aval bayit – ema la.
Ella missefa – mecharan leacher, rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich likkach lo derech, vachachamim omrim: tzarich.
Ha tu lema li? hayeynu hach! ella lav ha ka mashma lan – derabbi akiva savar: mocher beayin yafa mocher, verabbanan savri: mocher beayin raa mocher? shema minna.
Ittemar, rav huna amar rav:

a: Halacha kedivre chachamim. verav yirmeya bar abba amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi akiva. amar leh rav yirmeya bar abba lerav huna: "veha zimnin saggiin amrita kammeh derav: hilcheta kerabbi akiva, vela amar li vela midde!" amar leh: "hechi tenita?" amar leh: "ippecha tanena". "mishshum hachi la amar lach vela midde".
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: lema azdu letamayyhu –
Deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: haachin shechalku – en lahen lo derech ze al ze, velo sullamot ze al ze, velo challonot ze al ze, velo ammat hammayim ze al ze.
Vehizzaharu bahen, shehalachot kevuot hen. verav amar: yesh lahen.

Tzericha; dei ashmeinan behahi – behahi kaamar rav, mishshum daamar leh: baena lemedar beh ki hechi dedaru beh avahati; tidda, dichtiv: "tachat avotecha yihyu vanecha"; aval beha – ema mode leh lishmuel;
Vei ittemar beha – behach kaamar shemuel, aval beha – ema mode leh lerav; tzericha.
Amar leh rav nachman lerav huna: hilcheta kevotin, o hilcheta kevotayychu? amar leh: hilcheta kevotayychu, dimkarvitu levava deresh galuta, dishchichi dayyayne.
Ittemar: shene vattim ze lefanim mizze; shenehem bemecher, shenehem bemattana – en lahen derech ze al ze. kol shekken chitzon bemattana ufenimi bemecher.
Chitzon bemecher ufenimi bemattana – sevur minna: en lahen derech ze al ze;
Vela hi – mi la tenan: bamme devarim amurim – bemocher, aval benoten mattana – noten et kullan? alma man deyahev mattana – beayin yafa yahev; hacha name, man deyahev mattana – beayin yafa yahev.

Mishna hammocher et habbayit – machar et haddelet, aval lo et hammafteach; machar et hammachteshet kevua, aval lo et hammittaltelet; machar et haitzterovel, aval lo et hakkelet; velo et hattannur velo et hakkirayim. bizman sheamar lo: "hu vechol ma shebbetocho" –
b: Hare kullan mechurin.
Gemara lema matnitin dela kerabbi meir – dei rabbi meir, ha amar: machar et hakkerem – machar tashmishe cherem!
Afillu tema rabbi meir – hatam kevia, hacha la kevia. veha mafteach dumeya dedelet katane – ma delet dikvia, af mafteach dikvia! ella mechavvavrta, matnitin dela kerabbi meir.

Tanu rabbanan: hammocher et habbayit – machar et haddelet veet hanneger veet hammanul, aval lo et hammafteach; machar et hammachteshet hachakuka, aval lo et hakkevua; machar haitzterovel, aval lo et hakkelet, lo et hattannur, velo et hakkirayim, velo et harechayim. rabbi eliezer omer: kol hamechubbar lakkarka – hare hu kakkarka.
Bizman sheamar lo: "hu vechol ma shebbetocho" – hare kullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach – lo machar lo et habbor, velo et haddut, velo et hayyatzia.
Tanu rabbanan: tzinnor shechakako ulevassof kevao – posel et hammikve. kevao ulevassof chakako – eno posel et hammikve. manni? la rabbi eliezer vela rabbanan.
He rabbi eliezer? ilema rabbi eliezer devayit – dilma hayeynu tama, derabbi eliezer savar: mocher beayin yafa mocher, verabbanan savri: mocher beayin raa mocher!
Veella rabbi eliezer dechavvevret devorim? ditnan: kavvevret devorim – rabbi eliezer omer: hare hi kakkarka – vechotvin aleha perozbul,

a: Veenah mekabbelet tumea bimkomah, veharode mimmenna beshabbat – chayyayv chattat.
Vachachamim omrim: enah kakkarka – veen kotvin aleha perozbul, umekabbelet tumea bimkomah, veharode mimmenna beshabbat – patur.
Hatam – kidamar rabbi elazar tama, deamar rabbi elazar: may tama derabbi eliezer? dichtiv: "vayyitbol otah beyarat haddevash";
Ma yaar – hattolesh mimmennu beshabbat chayyayv chattat, af devash – harode mimmennu beshabbat chayyayv chattat!
Ella rabbi eliezer dedaf. ditnan: daf shel nachtomin shekkevao bakkotel – rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammein.
Manni? i rabbi eliezer – afillu chakako ulevassof kevao! i rabbanan – afillu kevao ulevassof chakako name!
Leolam rabbi eliezer hi, veshane peshute chele etz – detumea derabbanan.
Mikkelal dishiva deorayyta?!
b: Veha kayyma lan: derabbanan! veod, haamar rabbi yose ben rabbi chanina: bedaf shel mattechet machloket!
Leolam rabbanan hi, veshane sheiva derabbanan.
I hachi, afillu chakako ulevassof kevao name! shane hatam, deikka torat keli alav betalush.
Bae rav yosef: me geshamim shechishshev alehem lehaddiach et haitzterovlin, mahu lizraim?
Allibba derabbi eliezer, deamar: kol hamechubbar lakkarka – hare hu kakkarka, la tibbee lach; ki tibbee lach – allibba derabbanan, deamri: eno kakkarka. may? teku.
Shelach leh rav nechemya bereh derav yosef lerabba bereh derav huna zute, linhardea: ki atya hach itteta lekammach,
